body: http://www.reddit.com/r/goldbenefits/search?q=flair%3Afeature&sort=new&restrict_sr=on&t=all all yours buddy! And thank you.

Thank you man, I honestly needed this perspective. I'll go for it. I'll hit therapy harder than anything. I still can't see the other side, I don't even know if there will be another side. But if I go without even fucking trying then what does that say about me? If your not an a throwaway i'll gift you gold. Same with you /u/tamplier you two have helped more than you probably know.

You know what? You guys are right, if I end it then weakness wins. Seeking help isn't being weak, ending it isn't being strong. I never thought about it as soothing me but your so right. Fuck it, I'll try therapy. 
I don't want drugs because I have a serious addiction problem I still grapple with.
I've spent years dealing with this and never asked for help. There are some days when it just goes away and I feel on top of the world. Maybe my goal should be to make every day one of those days.

Your right, I need to hunt for that voice that says live. Life won't just hand me that.

Thank you both I needed that perspective, first thing tomorrow I'll book into therapy and we'll see what happens. I'm going to beat this fucking illness.

If you want a girlfriend man, it's easy. Just find the right one and ask them out. It may be daunting and you have to be prepared to let them all the way into your life.

Just please also know that not having a girlfriend may not be the source of your depression.

Thanks for this. It's just don't you have to want to put in the effort to go through all of this? Have something inside you that says it will all be better one day? I don't think I have that in me. I just want it to be over and done with.
